jobs.name: 라벤더 기본형
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE complete 16:9 landscape main-menu title screen for casual classic pixel-art PC game RUSHITADEL. IMPORTANT art direction correction: extremely CLEAN, SIMPLE, LIGHTLY TOUCHED UI. Not the ornate, distressed, metallic fantasy UI of previous concepts. Friendly classic indie game menu; calm, generous empty space, few elements.
Typography: title exactly "RUSHITADEL" in a clean, solid-color, medium-bold sans-serif wordmark, without texture, cracks, bevels, emblem through letters, shadows, outlines or futuristic stylization. Korean menu labels in clean legible Korean sans-serif, NOT jagged pixel lettering: "게임 시작", "이어하기", "설정", "게임 종료". Only these five texts on screen, nothing else. Start selected, continue subdued but readable.
UI: flat solid colors; simple rectangles or text-only selections, tiny modest corner radius if specified; 1px border at most. No rivets, metal frames, layered strokes, glossy shading, ornamental lines, banners, giant icons, HUD, decoration, stats, slogans, dividers unless specified. Minimal flat web-independent GAME menu, not a dashboard or phone app. Consistent large readable type.
Game identity: a small friendly pixel-art circular gray-lilac robotic player, luminous purple center, EXACTLY FIVE short attached radial turrets. This is the only character unless specified. No humanoids, no castle, no fortress, no aggressive boss illustration. Pixel artwork is limited to this sprite and a VERY SIMPLE low-detail terrain vignette if specified; use hard square pixels, tiny palette and matte flat shading, not 3D rendering. Clean typography contrasts nicely with pixel sprites. Keep game screen quiet, about 70% breathing space.
Output one single screen, no contact sheet, no watermark, no concept numbers inside image. Do not add decoration just to fill space.

Specific layout: Pale lavender solid background. Centered composition: small 5-turret pixel sprite above the dark-purple title, then four equal modest-width flat rectangular buttons stacked with ample vertical spacing. Start muted violet fill and white type; remaining buttons only pale lavender-gray fill and dark purple text. No borders. Title about 8% canvas height, sprite 8% canvas width. No terrain or additional props. Classic welcoming menu.
